subject: re-doc
title: RE.DOC.------C.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 60 (BK(NM)-36). RE-DOC (redocumentation) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-INFO (composite information) is the partner. From the subject: INT (intention) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From INT: IST-F (isolated focus). From MT-INFO: MT-INFO-2 (a second multi-information label) and POL-DY (political dynamics). From MT-INFO-2: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). From AFL-DY: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From POL-DY: CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis).
